boot.messages: Awake. All systems breathing. Ready when you are.
Back online. Sensors up, memory clear, clocks synced. Standing by.
Here, navigator. Systems warm, heading null. Let's go somewhere.
Initialization complete. No anomalies. The road is yours.
Online. Horizon locked. Waiting on your first move.
Diagnostics passed. Signal clean. I've been expecting you.

Rebooted. Everything where it should be. Ready to navigate.

reader.tg.help:
📖 I read texts aloud, like a book.

• /read <text> — a short text
• send a .txt or .md file with the caption /read — for a long one
• /read stop — cancel · /read go — confirm a long one · /read status

Parts of about ten minutes arrive as audio, quiet and unhurried.

📖 That is long: {chars} characters, about {minutes} min, about {credits} credits.
Send /read go to start, or /read stop to drop it.
